label: No Back Pockets
description: No back pockets leaves the seat of the trouser completely clean and uninterrupted, the most minimal and formal rear treatment. Without pocket openings the cloth lies smoothly over the seat, which flatters dress trousers and avoids sagging from carried items. It is favoured on the dressiest tailored and evening trousers.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
